messages.body_plain:
Hi there, 

T-LoCoH doesn't seem to work on the most recent version of R, when I try to install it I get the following error message: 

package ?tlocoh? is not available (for R version 3.2.5)Can you recommend an earlier version of R that works with T-LoCoH please? 

Many thanks, 

Lindy?Lindy Thompson, PhD, MSc, BSc (Hons)
National Research Foundation Postdoctoral Researcher
Kruger-to-Canyons Hooded Vulture Project
University of KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
E-mail: lindojano at yahoo.com
